answer: Price the right to exist. Each new agent bids in a rolling second-price auction for a scarce registration slot, and the clearing price climbs super-linearly as more identities join per minute. One honest newcomer pays only a walnut-sized fee, but a sybil flood hits a wall like a drill biting shale: every extra identity costs far more than the last, so N fakes cost far more than N times one. Proceeds fund random peer audits, leaving attackers bleeding violet ink while the commons keeps growing.
